messages:
maria (product): Heads-up — sales flagged a new customer ask from ZenHealth. They want 'zephyr-13b-open' pinned in APAC regions and available for Private (VPC/on-prem) deployment. Can we triage?

josh (sales): Confirming — ZenHealth pilot starts next quarter. Requirements: low-latency APAC endpoint, data-stays-in-region, and ability to run on their VPC. They want a stable model hash for 6 months. Quote: "must match our regulators' audit logs".

claire (solutions): Got it. Two quick Qs: (1) Do they need FP16 or quantized 8-bit? (2) Any custom finetune or just base open model?

josh (sales): No finetune initially, just base with deterministic version pin. They prefer quantized if it preserves accuracy — cost is a factor.

li (eng): Notes from infra: zephyr-13b-open currently only tested on x86 GPU fleet in NA. APAC rollout needs: image build + perf smoke tests on A100 and H100 in SG and IN zones. Private deploy: we need an on-prem packaging checklist (KMS, audit hooks). Potential blockers: custom ops for Zephyr's fused attention — might not be in our optimized kernels yet.

riley (catalog-bot): Catalog check: available variants = zephyr-13b-open (fp16), zephyr-13b-open-q4 (8-bit q4_0). Model artifact SHA: 9f3b2a...; license: permissive (requires attribution). No region pins currently.

claire (solutions): For compliance, ZenHealth will want explicit audit log entries for model hash on every deploy + per-request region tag. We should include checklist items in the intake.

maria (product): Proposed triage outcome: (A) Kick off model-onboard epi-ticket to build APAC images + perf tests; (B) Add Private packaging task (VPC readiness + KMS integration); (C) Catalog: create pinned model entry with recommended variant q4 and fallback to fp16; (D) Define acceptance criteria: perf SLOs in APAC tests (p95 < 120ms for 512 tokens), successful private install in staging, audit log present and immutable, legal signoff on license.

josh (sales): That sounds good. Can we get rough ETA for pilot readiness? ZenHealth needs dates for their procurement.

li (eng): Rough estimate: image + perf smoke in APAC = 3w (concurrent work), private packaging + staging run = 4w. Kernel work (if we need custom fused op) adds 2-3w but might be optional if q4 path works.

maria (product): OK — I'll open the intake ticket and mark priority as 'customer-pilot'. @riley please create the pinned catalog entry draft and link artifacts. @li please include a short rollback plan if q4 variant regresses.

riley (catalog-bot): Created draft catalog entry: /catalog/zephyr-13b-open/pin-drafts/zenhealth-apac-2150123456 — includes artifacts and license.

maria (product): Thanks team. Follow-up: I'll schedule a 20m sync with ZenHealth + solutions + eng to confirm acceptance criteria tomorrow. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Ticket #INF-4512 created and assigned to eng oncall for initial triage.
